attr.title: Hover!
attr.desc: Microsoft's capture-the-flag hovercraft maze racer from the Windows 95 CD, statically recompiled from its original executable into native code. Steer through the maze, grab the other team's flags before the drones grab yours, and use jumps, walls and cloaks to get there first.
attr.inst: Copy the files from your own Hover! folder (HOVER.EXE, DASHRES.DLL, WAVEMIX.INF, MAZES and SOUNDS, found in FUNSTUFF\HOVER on the Windows 95 CD) into ports/hover/gamedata.
